author: Dev Mehta

TDE_vs_AGN.physical_overlap: Both occur at galactic nuclei and exhibit persistently blue continuum emission.
TDE_vs_AGN.discriminating_observable: Slow power-law decline (t^-5/3) vs stochastic red-noise variability with non-zero structure function across years.
TDE_vs_AGN.pipeline_limitation: Surveys with <1 year baseline lack temporal depth to distinguish long-term AGN variability from late-stage TDE decay.

SLSN_II_vs_SN_IIn.physical_overlap: Both show strong circumstellar interaction (CSI) with narrow emission lines and prolonged optical luminosity.
SLSN_II_vs_SN_IIn.discriminating_observable: Total radiated energy (>10^51 erg) and absolute peak magnitude (M_peak < -21 mag).
SLSN_II_vs_SN_IIn.pipeline_limitation: Without accurate host redshift, absolute magnitude cannot be computed, forcing classification purely on apparent rise timescale.

Ca_rich_vs_SN_Ib.physical_overlap: Fast optical evolution and lack of prominent hydrogen features.
Ca_rich_vs_SN_Ib.discriminating_observable: Large galactic offset (>20 kpc) and low peak absolute magnitude (M_peak ~ -15 to -16 mag).
Ca_rich_vs_SN_Ib.pipeline_limitation: Lack of host-galaxy association features in pure photometric alert stream causes complete collapse into SN_CC.

unmapped_exotics_policy: Exotic transients lacking spectroscopic confirmation or clear physical counterpart are sequestered into NOT_EVALUABLE rather than forced into coarse classes.
